correctness.rationale: The physical trial and disjoint ancillary Slater state are orthonormal branches. Born probabilities weight the diagonal physical sector by lambda and ancillary sector by 1-lambda, while a cross-branch first moment scales as sqrt(lambda(1-lambda)); normalized estimator has the asserted first moment. Rescaling the exact diagonal second-moment operator of Zhao et al by 1/[4lambda(1-lambda)] gives b[1/lambda+S/(1-lambda)]-p0. S belongs to [1/(eta+1),1], so strict convexity yields lambda*=1/(1+sqrt(Sbar)); gain b(1-sqrt(Sbar))^2. The trial-equals-target Slater witness S=p0=1 requires the worst-case variance at least b/[lambda(1-lambda)]-1, attained uniquely for lambda=1/2 by the source sharp equal-weight upper bound.
